g.text: 12V_PAN also feeds existing F1 PAN PTC and F4 pendant path. No output regen clamp is selected; 12.6V servo limit is NOT proven.

g.desc: 12V_PAN also feeds existing F1 PAN PTC and F4 pendant path. No output regen clamp is selected; 12.6V servo limit is NOT proven.

g.text: PAN_INPUT target <=55V is an acceptance target, not a circuit guarantee. Never hot-connect an external supply to PAN_INPUT.

g.desc: PAN_INPUT target <=55V is an acceptance target, not a circuit guarantee. Never hot-connect an external supply to PAN_INPUT.

g.text: No PCB, extra-board location, qualified footprint/pad layout or service-clearance approval. Read README.md, pins.md and fault-review.md.

g.desc: No PCB, extra-board location, qualified footprint/pad layout or service-clearance approval. Read README.md, pins.md and fault-review.md.

g.text: OPEN RELEASE GATES: +BUS surge envelope, -42V reverse fault (controller limit -40V), startup current/SOA, thermal and EMI.

g.desc: OPEN RELEASE GATES: +BUS surge envelope, -42V reverse fault (controller limit -40V), startup current/SOA, thermal and EMI.

g.text: Q1/Q2 share SOURCE and GATE. All numbered source/drain leads are represented; stacked pins remain in exported netlist.

g.desc: Q1/Q2 share SOURCE and GATE. All numbered source/drain leads are represented; stacked pins remain in exported netlist.

g.text: U2-only tap after the existing head fuse. Shared C2/C3 BUS bypasses this circuit; upstream D8/D14 remain external.

g.text: FAULT unused (NC). RETRY=GND latches forward overcurrent only. SHDN_DIV defaults ON; UV/OV recovery is AUTOMATIC.

g.text: Momentarily grounding SHDN_DIV clears a forward fault. This is a reset/service node, NOT the ARM/safety line or emergency stop.
